derivation: from an unused root meaning to flee; swiftness;
def: Peleth, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
